name: Winnie (Weini)
notes: Handling end-to-end integration, board bring-up, and performance profiling on the FPGA. As of 2026-11-03, implemented int8 bias/GELU RTL and a parallel matmul readout prototype; completed TinyViT softmax reference, fixed-point model, bit-exact standalone RTL verification and standalone Quartus timing near 90 MHz. Full-SoC integration, calibrated GELU scales and board validation remain pending. See progress-2026-11-03.md.
